svg.title: Lifecycle · CyberAlchemy Lab concept map
svg.desc: Acceptance status, domain state and operation have separate rules. Authorized decisions select changes; an Admission Transaction saves the accepted record changes together. Select a node for its role, example and connections. Arrows are explanatory role connections.

g.title: The thing examined has separate domain, acceptance, format and operation states.
Lifecycle rules state which changes are permitted. Authorized decisions select the specific changes requested.
The transaction applies only the specific record changes and bookkeeping effects authorized by the decisions.
